book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Sousou Tehn
Nin sohrahn en Santi, Mery mehn Makdala ahpw kohla ni sousowo, ni eh wie rotorotete, e ahpw kilangada me takaio katapwursangehr mwohn sousowo.
Ih eri pwurete tenge Saimon Piter oh tohnpadahk teio, me Sises ketin loalloale, oh ndaiong ira, “Irail wahsangehr Kaun-o nan sousowo, oh se sehse wasa irail kihdiong ie!”
Piter oh tohnpadahk teio ahpw mwesellahng nin sousowo.
Ira wiahkinteieu tangala, a tohnpadahk teio me marahrahsang Piter, e lelohng nin sousowo mwohn Piter.
E ahpw itiekidi oh kilenglong, e ahpw kilangada likou linen kohte me wonohn wasao; e ahpw sohte pedolong loale.
Saimon Piter me idawehndo ahpw lelohng nin sousowo, oh pedolong loale. E ahpw pil kilangada likou linen ko me wonohn,
oh pil limwen pwudo me miher pohn kadokenmai, me sohte iang likou linen ko, a e limelimpene mi ekis wasa.
Eri, tohnpadahk teio, me tiengdohng nin sousowo, e ahpw pil pedolong loale, e ahpw kilangada oh kamehlele.
(Ira saikinte wehwehki mahsen en Pwuhk Sarawi, me e pahn iasada sang rehn me melahr akan.)
Tohnpadahk ko eri pwuralahng nan deura.
Sises Pwarohng Mery mehn Makdala
A Mery uh likin sousowo oh wie sengiseng. Ni eh wie sengiseng, e ahpw itiekidi pwe en kilenglong nan sousowo.
Eri, e ahpw kilangada tohnleng riemen me kapwatki likou pwetepwet. Ira mwohd wasa me kahlep en Sises ket ieo, emen wasa me kadokenmai mi ie, oh emen wasa me aluweluwe kan mi ie.
Ira ahpw ndaiong, “Lih, dahme ke sengisengki?” Liho ahpw ndaiong ira, “Ahki irail wahsangehr ei Kaun, oh I sehse wasa irail kihdiong ie!”
Ni eh ndaier met, e ahpw sohpeila oh kilangada Sises me ketin uh mpe, e ahpw sehse me ih Sises.

Sises eri mahsanihong, “Lih, dahme ke sengisengki? Ihs me ke raparapahki?” Pwehki Mery eh kihkihong me iei ih soumweto, e ahpw ndaiong, “Maing, ma komwi me wahsang, a komwi padahkihong ie wasa komw kihong ie, pwe I en kohla oh ale.”
Sises ahpw mahsanih, “Mery.” Mery ahpw sohpeiong oh patohwanohng, ni mahsen en Ipru, “Rapohni!” (me wehwehki “Sounpadahk.”)

Sises ahpw mahsanihong, “Pweisang ie mahs, pwe I saikinte pwuradalahng rehn Semei. A kohwei rehn riei ko oh ndaiong irail ni edei, ‘I pahn pwuradalahng rehn Semei oh pil Samamwail, rehn ei Koht oh pil amwail Koht.’”
Mery mehn Makdala eri kohla oh ndaiong tohnpadahk ko, “I kilangadahr Kaun-o!” E pil koasoiaiong irail duwen eh mahsanihong mepwukat.
Sises Pwarohng Sapwellime Tohnpadahk ko

Nin soutik en rahnohte, rahnen Santi, ni wenihmw ko ar ritidier, wasa me tohnpadahk ko pokopokon ie, pwehki arail masak mehn Suhs ko, Sises ahpw ketido uh nanpwungarail oh mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail popohl!”
Ni eh mahsanih met, e ahpw ketin kasalehiong irail lime ko oh pengepengeo. Tohnpadahk ko eri perenda ni ar kilangada Kaun-o.
Sises ahpw pil pwurehng mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail popohl!” Duwen Sahm eh ketin kadariehdo, ih duwen ei pahn kadarkumwailwei.”
Ni eh mahsanih met, e ahpw ketin peukohng irail angi, oh mahsanih, “Kumwail ale Ngehn Sarawi.
A ma kumwail pahn lapwahda dipen aramas akan, e pahn lapwada; a ma kumwail sohte pahn lapwahda, e sohte pahn lapwada.”
Tomas oh Sises
A Tomas, emen kisehn ehk riemeno (me pil adaneki Mpwer,) sohte mi rehrail ni ahnsou me Sises ketido rehrail.

Tohnpadahk teiko eri koasoiaiong, nda, “Se kilangadahr Kaun-o!” E ahpw ndaiong irail, “Ma I sohte kilang lipwen mete ko nin lime kan, oh kihlong nan lipwen mete ko sendin pehiet, oh pil kihlong pehi ni pengepengeo, I sohte pahn kamehlele.”
Mwurin wihk ehu, sapwellime tohnpadahk ko pil pokopokon nan ihmwo, oh Tomas pil iang irail. Ni wenihmw ko eh ritidier, Sises ahpw ketido uh nanpwungarail, oh mahsanih, “Kumwail popohl!”
E ahpw pil mahsanihong Tomas, “Kihdo sendin pehmwen met, oh kilang pehi kat; oh kihdo pehmwen, kihlong nan pengepengeiet; a ke dehr seupwoson, a kamehlele.”
Tomas eri patohwanohng, “Maing, ei Kaun oh ei Koht!”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong, “Ia duwe, ke kamehlele pwehki omw kilang ie? Meid pai irail kan me sohte kin kilang ahpw kamehlele!”
Kahrepen Pwuhk wet
Sises ketin wiadahr manaman tohrohr tohto mwohn sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, me sohte ntingdi nan pwuhk wet;
a mepwukat ntingdier pwe kumwail en pwoson me Sises iei ih me Mesaia, Sapwellimen Kohto; oh pwe, ni amwail pwoson, kumwail en ahneki mour ni mware.
